reviews.reason: renderReadonlySchemaNodes excludes keys already rendered structurally before mapping the remaining entries to readonly nodes, in object-entry order. The session test finds exactly one disabled name input for each structural key (type, properties) and each extra (title, description). Two bounded linear passes do not imply repeated recursive rendering.

One active/resetKey-gated initialization loads the base, rows, root, text and tab for one session. Deriving them each render would overwrite in-progress edits. The session test distinguishes a same-key parent echo from a new session; the inspector test saves independently edited fields and JSON.

schemaBase and schemaRoot are editable session inputs for schemaFromRows, not a view of the latest prop. The session test renames a field, delivers different props under the same resetKey, and reads the draft through getSchema; a different resetKey loads the replacement.

The module-level forwardRef passes a handle, not a DOM ref: the panel calls getSchema on Save. The session test reads a renamed draft through this handle and the inspector test asserts the saved nested schema in the document. This is a working imperative contract, not a removed API.

The reported calls invoke ordinary row/structure JSX helpers, not locally declared component types mounted as JSX. Nested inputs retain focus during a field rename; the inspector test also adds metadata.source and verifies its saved schema. This evidence does not review enum list keys.

updateSchemaRowsAtPath, applySchemaRowPatch, createSchemaRow and renderReadonlySchemaRow are called for their return values, not passed to children as identity-sensitive props. The inspector test keeps focus while renaming and saves an added nested property. Hoisting is possible organization, not a demonstrated remount fix.
